name: clema
description: Official hosted MCP server for Clema (clema.ai), an AI analyst for institutional research (IR) and institutional effectiveness teams in U.S. higher education. Work the IR data request queue and query the public IPEDS and College Scorecard datasets with read-only SQL from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, VS Code or any MCP client. OAuth sign-in in the browser, nothing to install. Requires a paid Clema plan; a free trial is available.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. OAuth 2.1 sign-in in the browser (authorization server https://oauth.clema.ai), no API key. Requires a Clema account.

tools.name: account_details
tools.description: Show details of the signed-in Clema account (read-only).

tools.name: ticket_details
tools.description: Get the details of one data request ticket (read-only).

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a new data request ticket (writes).

tools.name: update_ticket_settings
tools.description: Update the settings of a data request ticket (writes).

tools.name: data_tables
tools.description: List the available IPEDS and College Scorecard tables (read-only).

tools.name: data_dictionary_search
tools.description: Search the IPEDS and College Scorecard data dictionary (read-only).

tools.name: institution_search
tools.description: Search for institutions in the public datasets (read-only).

tools.name: data_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against the public IPEDS and College Scorecard datasets.
